title: Opt-in Needle router tool catalog for Alpine Nix
description: Needle only selects these deliberately constrained functions. Pi's separate built-in bash tool is not subject to this catalog; run Pi only on trusted inputs.

nix_version.description: Get the installed Nix package manager version without executing a user-supplied shell command.

list_workspace.description: List filenames under a directory located inside /workspace; relative path defaults to '.' and must not escape the workspace.

path.description: Relative directory inside /workspace; '.' is the root.

read_workspace_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file inside /workspace (up to 16 KiB); do not request secrets.

write_workspace_file.description: Create a new UTF-8 text file inside /workspace, only if the user explicitly enabled --execute --allow-write. Existing files are never overwritten.

content.description: Exact file contents; never store tokens or credentials.

run_safe_check.description: Run one of the built-in read-only diagnostics, never arbitrary shell text.

check.description: Named check from this fixed allowlist.
